description: Restored queries inside ordinary nested queries retain complete window identities. (Engine §4.4.)
grammar:
%rule text $p:A B
%conditions $p.ends(tail) ∧ $.ends(tail)
%rule tail $a:A [B]
%conditions $a.matches(inner)
%rule inner A [+T]
%conditions $.without-elision.onward.begins(deeper)
%rule deeper A [+T]
